title: ingest-ready.json
description: Structured handoff format from research skill to ingest-guide skill. Research produces this; ingest-guide consumes it. Eliminates re-parsing of raw research output.

source_id.description: Kebab-case identifier matching the ingest-guide source-id.

produced_by.description: Which skill or actor produced this artifact.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this artifact was generated.

claims.description: Atomic claims extracted from the source. Each claim is one distinct idea.

text.description: Verbatim or faithful summary of the claim.

upstream_url.description: Public URL cited by this specific claim, if any.

confidence.description: Researcher's confidence in the claim's accuracy.

upstream_urls.description: All public URLs mentioned in the source (deduplicated).

content_summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what the source is about.

excerpt.description: Short excerpt from fetched upstream, or null.

domain.description: Knowledge domain slug if classified by research domain gate.

raw_source_path.description: Path to the raw pasted content file that was the input to research.
